title: Bento pull-out: hero tile to full claim grid
summary: One hero tile fades up close on a white frame, then the camera pulls out while eight claim tiles slide inward and lock into a bento grid around it. The calm settle and long hold let a dense wall of proof points read as one statement.
use_when: A launch slide that has to show many short proof points at once (materials, specs, certifications)
Closing a product film on one summarising frame
Silent autoplay where one held frame must carry the message
A restrained, premium tone with light backgrounds and product photos

look.type_style: bold grotesk, lowercase and sentence case, tight tracking; hero claim 2 lines at ~6 % H, tile headlines 7-9 % H, tiny 1.5 % H captions; marker-style hand lettering in a saturated green on two tiles

sfx.event: camera pulls out from the hero tile to the full grid
each tile settles into its grid slot

structure.shot: blank white frame, then one wide hero tile (product photo left, wordmark and a 2-line claim right) fades up close
structure.camera: pull-out: hero tile 62 % W at 0.50 s -> 49 % W at rest (scale ~1.27 -> 1.00), motion.json -24.9 %/s
structure.motion: white until 0.27 s; hero tile fades 0 -> 1 over ~15 fr (±0.25 s), easings.outQuint; first neighbour tiles appear at the frame edges at 0.77 s

structure.shot: eight claim tiles (stats, struck-out materials list, product box photo, circuit photo) close in around the hero
structure.camera: pull-out continues and decelerates, motion.json -6.3 %/s, settles by ~1.77 s (±0.25 s), springs.cameraOut (overshoot not measurable)
structure.motion: tiles slide inward from beyond the frame edge toward the hero and fade 0 -> 1, stagger ~3-4 fr by distance (±0.25 s), springs.ui (overshoot not measurable); all tiles opaque and locked by 1.77 s

structure.shot: full bento of nine rounded tiles on white: hero centre, two columns left, one row above and below, dark photo tile right
structure.camera: static (motion.json 0.2 %/s, no change visible in cells 8-15)

params.brand: any brand.json: bg, fg, muted, accent (marker-style tiles), display font
params.content.hero: hero tile: product image, logo, 2-line claim (<= 4 words per line)
params.content.tiles: 8 tiles: {kind stat|list|image|mark, headline <= 3 words, caption <= 10 words, image?}
params.layout: bento slots as grid spans around the hero; recomposed per aspect
params.timing.heroIn: frame the hero starts fading in (default 8)
params.timing.pullOut: frames of the pull-out from hero to full grid (default 45)
params.timing.stagger: frames between tile arrivals, ordered by distance from the hero (default 3)

notes: One shot, no cuts, silent. Measured from 4 fps sheets and 1 fps keyframes: hero tile 62 % W at 0.50 s, 49 % W from 2.00 s (pull-out ~1.27x); motion.json zoom -24.9 %/s then -6.3 %/s then 0. Half the runtime is a static hold: the motion is only the build. Tiles enter from outside inward, never cross the hero. Proposed term bento-assemble (tiles converge into a mixed-span grid during a pull-out) is not in the vocabulary. sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured.
